method: Manual comparison of the live public ASSIST rendered page with its captured source and rebuilt structured data.
scope: Two rendered pages, including a general-education area and an agreement with unlinked source records. This is not a visual audit of every agreement.

samples.name: Biotechnology, B.S.
checks: The rendered agreement identifies 2026-2027, SBCC, and Cal Poly Pomona.
Cal-GETC area 1B and its five SBCC course choices agree with the source and rebuilt fields.
ENGL C1000 and C1000H are alternatives for ENG 1103; the saved conjunction is OR.
The university Calculus I requirement maps to SBCC MATH 150, 5 units.

samples.name: BIOMEDICAL ENGINEERING [BS]
checks: The corrected viewByKey link opens this specific 2026-2027 agreement directly.
BIO 1151 maps to BIOL 103, 5 units; CHEM 1120 and 1122 map to CHEM 155 and 156.
The calculus sequence requires MATH 150, 160, and 200; linear analysis requires MATH 210 and 220.
The page includes structured one-course selection advisements, which the updated converter retains.
The two unlinked API records, PHYS 2211 and MCRO 2224, are absent from the rendered requirements and are preserved separately.
